12483.name: Matthew Stafford
12483.note: Stafford completed 26 of 43 passes for 228 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders. He added one yard on his only carry.

14012.name: Andy Dalton
14012.note: Dalton is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bengals but was designated as his team's emergency third quarterback.

14880.name: Kirk Cousins
14880.note: Cousins completed 22 of 32 passes for 216 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed twice for no gain and scored a rushing touchdown.

15168.name: Case Keenum
15168.note: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Bears' emergency No. 3 quarterback for Sunday Night Football versus the Buccaneers.

15847.name: Travis Kelce
15847.note: Kelce brought in four of six targets for 72 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday. He also rushed once for one yard.

15864.name: Geno Smith
15864.note: Smith completed 18 of 32 passes for 165 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs. He also rushed once for eight yards.

16733.name: Odell Beckham Jr.
16733.note: The Vikings are signing Beckham from the practice squad to the active roster, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.

16737.name: Mike Evans
16737.note: Evans (Achilles), who won't play in Sunday's game against the Raiders, appears to be "questionable at best" for next Sunday's road matchup with the Cowboys, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

2573079.name: Carson Wentz
2573079.note: Wentz is stated to start Monday night's game against the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

2573401.name: Tyler Higbee
2573401.note: Higbee caught one of two targets for 14 yards against the Chargers in Sunday's 24-9 victory.

2576336.name: Ameer Abdullah
2576336.note: Abdullah carried the ball seven times for 30 yards and returned one kickoff for 24 yards in Thursday night's 33-10 win over the Ravens.

2576925.name: Darren Waller
2576925.note: Waller caught eight of 10 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.

2577417.name: Dak Prescott

2578570.name: Jacoby Brissett
2578570.note: The Ravens acquired Brissett and a 2027 fifth-round pick from the Cardinals on Friday in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round pick and a 2028 seventh-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

2973405.name: Kalif Raymond
2973405.note: Raymond finished Monday's 34-17 win against Seattle with two catches for 14 yards on three targets along with one rush for 39 yards.

2976212.name: Stefon Diggs
2976212.note: Diggs caught three of five targets for 51 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

2977187.name: Cooper Kupp
2977187.note: Kupp caught one of three targets for a seven-yard touchdown Monday in a loss to the Bears.

2983509.name: Dare Ogunbowale

2991662.name: Mack Hollins
2991662.note: Hollins (calf) is listed as active for Sunday's game against the Packers.

2998565.name: Mo Alie-Cox

3040151.name: George Kittle

3042519.name: Aaron Jones Sr.

3046439.name: Hunter Henry
3046439.note: Henry caught all three of his targets for 35 yards during Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Packers.

3046779.name: Jared Goff

3047876.name: KhaDarel Hodge
3047876.note: The 49ers elevated Hodge from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

3051876.name: Evan Engram
3051876.note: Engram failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.

3051889.name: Laquon Treadwell
3051889.note: Treadwell caught one of two targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

3054850.name: Alvin Kamara
3054850.note: Kamara rushed six times for 32 yards while catching three of four targets for 17 yards during Sunday's 23-22 overtime win against the Browns.

3068267.name: Austin Ekeler
3068267.note: Ekeler rushed eight times for 36 yards in Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

3116164.name: Mike Gesicki
3116164.note: Gesicki caught both of his targets for 11 yards during Sunday's 34-17 win versus Atlanta.

3116165.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
3116165.note: Godwin caught two of three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard rush during Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

3116365.name: Mark Andrews
3116365.note: Andrews secured both targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

3116389.name: Samaje Perine
3116389.note: Perine rushed four times for 10 yards and caught his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.

3116407.name: Mason Rudolph
3116407.note: Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

3117251.name: Christian McCaffrey

3117256.name: Dalton Schultz
3117256.note: Schultz caught two of four targets for 42 yards in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.

3121023.name: Dallas Goedert
3121023.note: Goedert caught five of six targets for 50 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants.

3122840.name: Deshaun Watson
3122840.note: Watson (concussion) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Saints, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

3123076.name: David Njoku

3127586.name: Jeremy McNichols
3127586.note: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

3128429.name: Courtland Sutton
3128429.note: Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.

3134353.name: Tim Patrick
3134353.note: Patrick is inactive (coach's decision) for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

3886598.name: Jauan Jennings

3915411.name: Ty Johnson

3915416.name: DJ Moore
3915416.note: Moore (shoulder) doesn't have a designation for Monday's contest at Minnesota.

3917914.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
3917914.note: Zaccheaus (head) has returned to Sunday's matchup against Cincinnati in Madrid, Spain, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

3925357.name: Calvin Ridley
3925357.note: Ridley caught one of three targets for 10 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

3930066.name: Van Jefferson

3930086.name: Dawson Knox

4040761.name: Devin Singletary

4241985.name: J.K. Dobbins

4242355.name: Jake Ferguson

4242433.name: Joshua Palmer

4243331.name: Cade Otton
4243331.note: Otton wasn't targeted in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

4248425.name: Carlos Washington Jr.

4248528.name: Christian Watson
4248528.note: Watson secured seven of eight targets for 171 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

4257188.name: Charlie Jones
4257188.note: Jones (hand) is active for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

4257364.name: Zavier Scott
4257364.note: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.

4258173.name: Nico Collins
4258173.note: Collins corralled all four of his targets for 55 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 44-22 victory at the Chargers.

4259305.name: Bo Melton
4259305.note: Melton exited Sunday's game against the Patriots and is being evaluated for a concussion.
